visualCharacteristics.purpose: Horizontally sliding list of featured hotels under a Where to Stay heading
visualCharacteristics.layout: item count label, scroll-snap track (1/2/3 visible by viewport), prev/next arrows, page dots; image links to the same hotel URL as the name

contentPattern.structure: one row per hotel; cell 1 is the hotel image, cell 2 is a paragraph with the hotel name linked to its page

usage: Where to Stay section of travel articles and quizzes; heading, subtitle and Explore More Hotels button stay as default content around it.
reuseGuidance: Use for any linked image carousel of hotels. The "N Hotels" label is computed from the row count.
